modeling_role: Allows separate effects to be summed in one model
distortion_risk: Interactions or feedback can make combined effects different from the sum of individual effects
review_warning: Review interaction terms subgroup residuals and mechanism assumptions

modeling_role: Assumes effects scale consistently with input magnitude
distortion_risk: Saturation thresholds scarcity or overload can change marginal effects
review_warning: Check whether the model is local global or extrapolated

modeling_role: Assumes relationships remain stable over the modeled range
distortion_risk: Regime shifts time variation policy changes or behavioral adaptation can change coefficients
review_warning: Validate across periods scenarios and operating regimes

modeling_role: Uses a linear model to approximate behavior near an operating point
distortion_risk: Local accuracy can be mistaken for global validity
review_warning: State the operating range and check approximation error

modeling_role: Uses unexplained structure as evidence about model adequacy
distortion_risk: Ignoring structured residuals can hide curvature thresholds or missing variables
review_warning: Inspect residual patterns before interpreting coefficients

modeling_role: Summarizes broad structure through average relationships
distortion_risk: Averages can hide subgroup spatial temporal or network heterogeneity
review_warning: Review disaggregated behavior and subgroup errors

modeling_role: Uses a fitted relationship outside the observed or validated range
distortion_risk: Predictions may cross thresholds constraints or regimes not represented in the model
review_warning: Flag out-of-range predictions and require additional validation

modeling_role: Interprets coefficients as effects of changing inputs
distortion_risk: Association can be mistaken for causal mechanism
review_warning: Separate prediction association mechanism and causal identification
